name: io.github.jamesbrink/mcp-coroot
description: MCP server for the Coroot observability platform: applications, logs, traces, profiles, metrics, incidents and alerts

environmentVariables.name: COROOT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the Coroot instance, e.g. https://coroot.example.com

environmentVariables.name: COROOT_SESSION_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Existing coroot_session cookie, for SSO or MFA logins

environmentVariables.name: COROOT_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default project id used when a tool call omits project_id

environmentVariables.name: COROOT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only tools that read from Coroot
